{{Quote|And most impressive of all, I found the Holocron of King Nakgru.|Sorzus Syn, ''Chronicle of Sorzus Syn''|<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Nakgru''' was an individual who ruled as a [[Sith King]]<ref name="Book of Sith" /> before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 16,899 BBY.<ref name="Date">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' (p. 27) states that latter part of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle took place in the "Exile Year Two, Months 7-9". Per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' the first year took place in [[6900 BBY]], thus the second year would be [[6899 BBY]]. Page 29 states that the Sanctum of Sakkra-Kla was sealed more than ten thousand years before 6899 BBY, and lain undisturbed since, which would mean that [[Holocron of King Nakgru]] was placed there before 16,899 BBY. Therefore, Nakgru would have ruled before that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> The [[Holocron of King Nakgru]] eventually came be be placed inside the [[Sanctum of Sakkra-Kla]], a sacred [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tomb that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where it lay undisturbed for over ten thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Book of Sith" /> In [[6899 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sorzus Syn]] penetrated the Sanctum of Sakkra-Kla and discovered the Nakgru Holocron. She subsequently studied the device and learned from it the history of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Purebloods]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
